caption: The drawing depicts three distinct objects arranged on a light beige background. In the upper left quadrant is a large, L-shaped object consisting of a cylindrical, brown wooden handle horizontally attached to a larger, vertical, reddish-brown component that appears to partially encase the end of the handle. The wood grain on the handle is visible, and the end of the vertical piece is slightly darker in shade. In the lower right, there is a close-up detail showing the end of a similar brown wooden cylinder inserted into what looks like a reddish-brown, rounded socket that fits snugly around it. In the center of the drawing is a smaller, circular object with a reddish-brown border; inside, a beige, circular face is bisected horizontally by a metallic or yellowish-brown element, possibly a fastener or connection, with a visible screw or pin head. The background is bordered by a simple, thin rectangular line, and the artist's signature "C. LARENCE HORTON" appears in the lower right corner. The composition is simple, with the objects spaced apart and rendered with careful attention to color and material texture.
title: Zoar Shingle Axe
